meta_description: ene turns a few lines of text into a diagram where data travels the arrows.
meta_home_description: ene turns a few lines of text into an animated diagram: data travels the arrows, so you see what goes first, where it waits and where it fails. Export SVG, GIF or MP4, or embed a player.
meta_examples_description: Fourteen ene diagrams to start from: orders, login, caches, queues, sagas, webhooks, VPCs and sequence diagrams. Open any of them in the playground.
meta_playground_description: Write ene in the browser and watch it render as you type. Share a link, or download SVG, GIF and MP4.
meta_example_description: {blurb} An animated ene diagram you can open and edit in the playground.
meta_docs_suffix: From the ene docs: turn a few lines of text into an animated diagram.
meta_og_image_alt: ene: an animated diagram where data travels the arrows
meta_keywords: animated diagram, text to diagram, diagram as code, sequence diagram, flowchart, architecture diagram, SVG animation, Mermaid alternative
home_title: ene · Diagrams that show what happens
home_lede: Write a few lines of text. ene turns them into a diagram where data travels the arrows: what goes first, where it waits, where it fails.
home_syntax_h2: Three arrows. That is the language.
home_syntax_p: Name a node once, then write who calls whom. ene handles layout, timing and playback.
home_arrow_request_text: The dot travels along the line to the next node.
home_arrow_response_text: It comes back the other way, on the same edge.
home_arrow_failure_text: The dot stops halfway and turns red. Nothing returns.
home_branches_p: Write both outcomes with branch and else. Viewers choose which one plays, in the same picture.
home_embed_p: Export a self-playing SVG. It animates anywhere an image does: GitHub, Notion, your docs. No script tag.
examples_p: Each one is a short .ene file. Open it, change a line in the playground, watch it replay.
ex_01_blurb: Parallel calls and a payment timeout.
ex_02_blurb: An expired token, a refresh, a retry.
ex_04_blurb: Work handed off and consumed later.
ex_06_blurb: Edge cache in front of the origin.
ex_07_blurb: Failures, waits and a final approval.
ex_08_blurb: A distributed transaction and its compensation.
ex_10_blurb: Writes that update a search index.
ex_12_blurb: A full storefront in one diagram.
ex_14_blurb: The same kind of flow as a sequence diagram.
